scope: public generic and private checked named-property ASCII guards, reserved dispatch, and complete typed property-find caller; shared complete field validation and packed short literal nominal getter
adaptation: Accept exactly ASCII letters, digits, underscore and dollar via two u64 masks, with an equivalent wrapping-subtraction lowercase fast path. Reject non-ASCII UTF-16 units before modulo-64 shifts. Validate every unit before rejecting pinned reserved spellings through length/first-unit dispatch; empty names remain accepted. After the matching reserved-length bucket is exhausted, return accepted without testing disjoint lengths. This original checked guard rejects unsupported munging rather than porting upstream code; provenance does not establish execution. The public generic body remains canonical. A private non-null STRING specialization removes only already-proven type casts and its entry guard. Its complete closed generator and complete property-find caller are independently pinned; each table entry is guarded before checked validation, and malformed late entries still reject. The checked property-find route changes neither the GC value layout nor cross-call caching. The combined private checked helper validates the complete field then compares UTF-16 units using its captured length. Invalid fields directly throw the existing nominal language error instead of returning false to the former caller-side throw. Public generic bodies remain byte-identical source generators. The checked helper emits its complete unit guard from one closed closure at prefix positions0..3 and in the unchanged fallback loop beginning4. Short-length branches exit only the character block; full reserved-name rejection still precedes equality. The complete checked field validator is factored into one source generator used by both checked comparison signatures. A compiler-proven sole-use adjacent literal of up to four UTF16 units may use a callback-free two-result probe: explicit i32 hit status and VALUE distinguish genuine nil/false fields from misses. Full live schema validation, last duplicate winner and late errors precede every nominal hit. On a miss or excluded receiver, the compiler emits its original UTF16 ArrayNewFixed literal and invokes the original dispatcher once. The elided key GC local holds the probe value only until branch selection; before a fallback callback it again holds the genuine STRING. The legacy getter remains available and shares the same checked probe. Closed identities bind the shared validator, both comparisons, probe and legacy getter. Generic guard and typed property-find identities remain unchanged. No hash callback, guest effect, GC layout or ABI version is changed; the new probe adds an internal runtime function export/import.
guard-location: Named instance access must not mistake raw source names for munged fields.
typed-precondition: property-find guards each entry and query as STRING; combined private helper fully validates each field before equality, throwing nominal language error on invalid field; full scan including late entries
short-precondition: packed raw UTF16 query length <=4; probe returns explicit hit/value only after complete live schema validation and last-duplicate scan; miss/excluded receivers return false/nil without callbacks; compiler fallback constructs the original literal and invokes the original dispatcher once; legacy getter shares inspection
